factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated EBITDA for 06 months of 2026 decreased by 0.8% and was 7 508 thousand EUR, compared to 7 566 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025. EBITDA margin = EBITDA / revenue = 26.3% (06m 2026) vs 26.6% (06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: The largest deterioration was in net earnings: consolidated net profit fell 31.2% to €4.321 million, while profit attributable to the parent’s equity holders decreased 31.5% to €3.961 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Reported consolidated net profit for 06 months of 2026 amounted to 4 321 thousand EUR, as compared to net profit of 6 279 thousand EUR in the prior year’s same period. Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company for 06 months of 2026 amounted 3 961 thousand EUR (vs 5 781 thousand EUR in 06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share declined from €0.16 to €0.11, and the attributable net profit margin fell from 20.3% to 13.9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Earnings per share (EUR) for 06m 2026: 0.11 (vs 0.16 for 06m 2025). Net profit margin attributable to equity holders of the Parent company for 06 months of 2026 was 13.9% against net profit margin 20.3% for 06 months of 2025.

factual_claims.claim: The decline in net profit occurred despite profit before tax decreasing less sharply, from €7.601 million to €6.191 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit before tax for 06 months of 2026 amounted to 6 191 thousand EUR, as compared to 7 601 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Net finance income fell to €444 thousand from €1.652 million in the prior-year period, mainly because the previous period included substantially higher currency exchange income.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net finance income for 06 months of 2026 amounted to 444 thousand EUR (vs 1 652 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025). Currency exchange income/(expense) was 152 thousand EUR (vs 1 438 thousand EUR in prior period).

factual_claims.claim: Income tax expense also increased to €1.870 million from €1.322 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income tax expense for 06 months of 2026 was 1 870 thousand EUR (vs 1 322 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025).

factual_claims.claim: In the second quarter alone, revenue rose 2.2% to €16.774 million, but operating profit fell 10.9% to €4.060 million and net profit attributable to parent shareholders was broadly stable at €3.048 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue from contracts with customers for 2Q 2026: 16 774 thousand EUR (vs 16 412 thousand EUR in 2Q 2025, +2.2%). Operating profit for 2Q 2026: 4 060 thousand EUR (vs 4 559 thousand EUR in 2Q 2025, -10.9%). Profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company for 2Q 2026: 3 048 thousand EUR (vs 3 029 thousand EUR in 2Q 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Russia remained the largest market, accounting for 55.1% of sales, although revenue declined 0.6% in euros and 7.8% in local currency.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The majority of lingerie sales revenue during 06 months of 2026 in the amount 15 767 thousand EUR was generated in Russia, accounting for 55.1% of total sales. Russia sales in EUR: 15 767 thousand EUR (vs 15 857 thousand EUR in 06m 2025, -0.6%). Local currency sales decreased by 7.8% during 06 months of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Belarus sales increased 6.4% to €9.046 million, or 2.7% in local currency, partly offsetting the Russian decline.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s sales in Belarus in the 06 months of 2026 were 9 046 thousand EUR and increased by 6.4% compared to the 06 months of 2025. Sales in local currency increased by 2.7% during the same period.

factual_claims.claim: The Group continued to focus on improving Russian retail profitability and operated 67 own stores there at period-end, compared with 69 at year-end 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: At the end of the reporting period, there were a total of 67 stores operated by the Group itself (as of 31 December 2025: 69 stores).

factual_claims.claim: Across the network, directly operated stores decreased from 137 to 135, while total own and franchise stores numbered 547.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: At the end of the reporting period the Group and its franchising partners operated 525 Milavitsa and 22 Lauma Lingerie brand stores, including 135 stores operated directly by the Group (as of 31 December 2025: 137 stores). Total own and franchise stores: 547.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow nearly doubled to €6.842 million from €3.481 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net cash flow from operating activities for 06m 2026: 6 842 thousand EUR (vs 3 481 thousand EUR for 06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents rose 87.4% to €12.443 million, while total assets increased 5.1% to €98.603 million and parent-attributable equity rose 6.1% to €81.479 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash and cash equivalents at 30.06.2026: 12 443 thousand EUR (+87.4% vs 6 639 thousand EUR at 31.12.2025). Total assets: 98 603 thousand EUR (+5.1% vs 93 847 thousand EUR at 31.12.2025). Equity attributable to equity holders of the Parent company: 81 479 thousand EUR (+6.1% vs 76 768 thousand EUR at 31.12.2025).

factual_claims.claim: The 2025 net profit of €9.229 million was retained rather than distributed as dividends.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Annual General Meeting approved the net profit for the financial year 2025 of 9 229 thousand EUR and decided to leave the net profit undistributed and include it in retained earnings.
